job: Show whether the product is healthy: an icon when normal, a labelled pill when not.
purpose: A link to the status page in the top bar. When operational it is an icon alone, with its label for assistive technology and a tooltip. When degraded, down or in maintenance it shows its label in a tone, so a problem is read where it matters. The page sets it with setServiceStatus(); the control fetches nothing itself.
useWhen: People depend on the service and should see an incident without looking for a status page.
A top bar needs a quiet place for 'all good' that turns into words when it is not.

avoidWhen.when: A person's own job or resource is unhealthy.
A message that must be read and dismissed.

parts.role: The link to the status page; data-status sets the look.
The words; visually hidden when operational, hidden on a phone otherwise (aria-label keeps the name).

keyboard.does: Follows the link to the status page.
